scope: One MOCK-only country-dependent required dropdown; exact mapped answer fill and fail-closed handling of a newly revealed unmapped required control.

test_environment.ats: local synthetic MOCK fixture with Playwright

test_first.red_result: Expected failure before implementation: both paths reached the static form validity error after country revealed the dependent required field.

validations.summary: 42 tests passed, 0 failures, 0 skips after clean rebase onto 27ca5ccb3cdf6e2e37079e53d721a55068cbd7eb.

acceptance_observations.known_dependent_dropdown: After the approved United States answer revealed State or province, the browser re-read visible required controls and filled Oklahoma only through the exact preflight question ID and a verified, user-approved profile answer. The synthetic ATS accepted the dependent field at its review endpoint.
acceptance_observations.unknown_required_control: An unlisted required control produced persisted UNKNOWN/UNKNOWN_DYNAMIC_REQUIRED_FIELD and REVIEW_REQUIRED, remained readable after SQLite reopen and application detail API read, and stopped before review or submit POSTs.
acceptance_observations.request_counts: Known field path: 1 mock review POST, 0 submit POSTs. Unknown required path: 0 review POSTs, 0 submit POSTs; receipt remained not_found.
acceptance_observations.privacy: The DOM snapshot includes only bounded control IDs/names/tag/required visibility; it does not read candidate control values or rendered labels. Attempt and audit output contains stable reasons and IDs only.
acceptance_observations.origin_and_gates: The exercised browser context retains the existing fixed mock-origin route guard. Existing CAPTCHA, intervention, cancellation, and submission authorization code was not changed.
